statements.quote: Our generative AI book of business now stands at more than $3 billion, up more than $1 billion quarter to quarter
statements.notes: The filing says 'more than $3 billion', so this is a lower bound. 'Book of business' is IBM's cumulative inception-to-date measure (software transactional revenue, SaaS annual contract value and consulting signings). It is not revenue recognized in fiscal 2024, so do not treat it as annual AI revenue. No year is stated; it is a cumulative figure as of Q3 2024.
